_comment: SystemConfig registry (§1a). DEFAULT / all-off baseline: every system OFF so the canonical world_hash (d950a6afc12a5cdc) and visual baselines stay byte-identical. Spec: .forge/specs/system-config/spec.md. sim.* may change sim state (hashed when enabled); render.* is render-only (never hashed). systems.game.json is the intended-ON profile.

sim._ecology_comment: Creature-brain tuning (spec 011). enabled:false -> the compiled defaults are used (byte-identical). Set enabled:true to apply these values; the shown values ARE the defaults, so flip enabled alone changes nothing until you tweak a number. Levers: energy/sleep cadence, hunger/stamina pacing, herd cohesion (herd_weight/alignment_weight), predator reach (catch_radius/satiation).
sim._fullcontrol_comment: Per-system creature tuning (spec 011 full-control). Each enabled:false -> compiled defaults (byte-identical); the shown values ARE the defaults. Flip enabled:true + edit a number to tune live. sim.* are hashed when enabled; the canonical baseline keeps them all OFF.
sim._hydrology_weather_comment: S1.1 (ATMO-11/WATER-07): weather-driven rain into the spec-010 hydrology (per-cell PrecipitationAt, integer-quantized). Activation implies finite hydrology semantics; a deliberate hash bump on the activation menu.
sim._weather_events_comment: S1.2 (ATMO-12): the deterministic Markov weather-event epochs (WeatherEventAt, seed+25) exposed via GameSession::CurrentWeatherEvent. OFF -> always Clear/0 (byte-identical); consumers must also be participants.

render._spawn_comment: Client-only ambient living-world spawn (never hashed). enabled:false -> compiled defaults. Tune how many creatures/ants populate the world + their speeds.
render._wave_g_comment: Wave G R1 bridges (ATMO-07/AETHER-04/ATMO-14): default-OFF until the R1.X batched WorldVisualSweep re-bless flips them ON.
